categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP server initialization and RPC binding logic in src/httpserver.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a local credential leak where bitcoind fails open on IPv6 if IPv4 loopback binding fails, allowing a rogue local process to intercept bitcoin-cli cookie authentication over IPv4 and hijack the node. Reviewers verified this closes a real credential leak on multi-user systems.
